The order bound prohibits a proper nontrivial central simple subfactor there being new (the whole factor itself would add only one); if of bounded dimension only boundedly many commuting new ones fit. Thus the list of distinct component algebras on the whole line is absolutely bounded (at most four from the original two labels plus those new ones). Each designated algebra consists of one or two such components tensoring and determines the stabilizer (it and its tensor commutant determine the ordered tensor).
